title: Equivalence of Supercuspidal Data
body_html:
Equivalence of Supercuspidal Data

Two supercuspidal data \[ \Sigma=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho),\qquad \Sigma'=(x',\Gamma',\phi',\rho') \] for \(G\) are equivalent if there exists \(g\in G\) such that \[ x=gx',\qquad \operatorname{Ad}_g(\Gamma')\in \Gamma+\mathbf g_{x,0}, \] and the finite reductive quotient representations satisfy \[ \rho'\otimes\phi'\simeq(\rho\otimes\phi) ∘ \operatorname{Ad}_g. \]

For the classical groups treated in the paper, the Hakim-Murnaghan equivalence relation reduces to this \(G\)-conjugacy form, because the center is anisotropic and refactorization is absorbed into the semisimple element. The attached representations are isomorphic exactly when the data are equivalent.
